-- discord.gg/syncrypt

local function geniter(f, s, c)
	if type(f) ~= "function" then
		local mt = getmetatable(f)

		if type(mt) == "table" and mt.__iter then
			f, s, c = mt.__iter(f)
		elseif type(f) == "table" then
			f, s, c = next, f, nil
		end
	end

	return function()
		local r = table.pack(f(s, c))

		if r[1] == nil then
			return false
		end

		c = r[1]

		return true, table.unpack(r, 1, r.n)
	end
end

		end

spilled.t12.barra = function(p344, p345)
	if not p345 or p345 <= 0 then
		return ""
	end

	local v3912 = math.clamp(p344 / p345, 0, 1)
	local v3913 = math.floor(v3912 * 12 + 0.5)

	return string.rep("|", v3913) .. string.rep(".", 12 - v3913) .. string.format(" %d%%", math.floor(v3912 * 100))
end
spilled.t12.numero = function(p346)
	local v3914 = tonumber(p346) or 0

	if v3914 >= 1e12 then
		return string.format("%.2fT", v3914 / 1e12)
	end

	if v3914 >= 1e9 then
		return string.format("%.2fB", v3914 / 1e9)
	end

	if v3914 >= 1000000 then
		return string.format("%.2fM", v3914 / 1000000)
	end

	if v3914 >= 1000 then
		return string.format("%.1fk", v3914 / 1000)
	end

	return tostring(math.floor(v3914))
end

_G.__TSUO_SoltarBoneco = function()
	local Character = spilled.LocalPlayer.Character

	if not Character then
		return false, "sem personagem"
	end

	local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local t124 = {}

	if HumanoidRootPart then
		if HumanoidRootPart.Anchored then
			HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = false
			t124[#t124 + 1] = "anchor"
		end

		if HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 1 or HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude > 1 then
			HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			t124[#t124 + 1] = "momentum"
		end
	end

	if Humanoid then
		if Humanoid.SeatPart or Humanoid.Sit then
			Humanoid.Sit = false
			t124[#t124 + 1] = "seat"
		end

		if Humanoid.PlatformStand then
			Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
			t124[#t124 + 1] = "platform"
		end

		pcall(function()
			for _, v in ipairs(Humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
				if v.WeightCurrent and v.WeightCurrent > 0.5 then
					v:Stop(0)
					t124[#t124 + 1] = "anim"
				end
			end
		end)
		pcall(function()
			Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running, true)
			Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
			Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
		end)
	end

	_G.__TSUO_SolturaUltima = #t124 > 0 and "freed: " .. table.concat(t124, ", ") or "nothing was holding you"

	return true, _G.__TSUO_SolturaUltima
end

								CFrame = v5776.CFrame
							})

spilled.t12.favoritarMelhores = function(p495)
	local v5784 = spilled.v3448()
	local v5785 = spilled.v1778(spilled.t51.PetFavorite)

	if not v5785 then
		return 0
	end

	local v5786 = math.max(1, tonumber(p495) or 3)
	local t165 = {}

	for i = 1, math.min(v5786, #v5784) do
		if v5784[i] then
			t165[v5784[i].uid] = true
		end
	end

	local n168 = 0
	local n169 = 0

	for i = 1, #v5784 do
		local v5792 = v5784[i]

		if v5792 then
			if t165[v5792.uid] and not v5792.favorito then
				pcall(function()
					v5785:FireServer(v5792.uid, true)
				end)
				n168 += 1
				task.wait(0.12)
			elseif not t165[v5792.uid] and v5792.favorito then
				pcall(function()
					v5785:FireServer(v5792.uid, false)
				end)

			end
		end
	end

	_G.__TSUO_EGG_FAVORITOS = string.format("%s travou %d, soltou %d de %d pets", os.date("%H:%M:%S"), n168, n169, #v5784)

	return n168
end

spilled.t12.wispMissaoAtual = function(p503)

		return nil
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return require(spilled.ReplicatedStorage.Data.WispQuests)
	end)

	if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" or type(result.List) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end

	local List = result.List
	local v5800 = tonumber(p503.Stage) or 0

	return List[v5800], result
end
spilled.t12.wispEspeciesEF = function()
	if spilled.t12.wispEFcache then
		return spilled.t12.wispEFcache
	end

	local wispEFcache = {}

	pcall(function()
		local enchantedForest = require(spilled.ReplicatedStorage.Data.Areas).Directory["Enchanted Forest"]
		local DropTable = enchantedForest.DropTable or {}

		for _, v in ipairs(DropTable) do
			wispEFcache[tostring(v[1])] = true
		end
	end)

	if next(wispEFcache) then
		spilled.t12.wispEFcache = wispEFcache
	end

	return wispEFcache
end

spilled.t12.wispMaiorTrioEF = function()

	end

	local wispTrioN = 0

	pcall(function()

		local v5809 = spilled.t12.wispEspeciesEF()
		local t166 = {}
		local Inventory = v5808.Inventory or {}

		for _, v in pairs(Inventory) do
			local v5814 = tostring(v.Category)

			if v5809[v5814] and v.IsFavorite ~= true and v.InFuse ~= true then
				t166[v5814] = (t166[v5814] or 0) + 1

				if wispTrioN < t166[v5814] then
					wispTrioN = t166[v5814]
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	spilled.t12.wispTrioEm = os.clock()
	spilled.t12.wispTrioN = wispTrioN

	return wispTrioN
end

		end

		local wispMissaoAtual = spilled.t12.wispMissaoAtual

			return tostring(p505) == tostring(v5817.Match.AreaId) and spilled.t12.wispMaiorTrioEF() < 3
		end

		if not v5817 or type(v5817.Match) ~= "table" or v5817.Event ~= "EggSecured" then
			return false
		end

		if v5817.Match.AreaId ~= nil and tostring(p505) ~= tostring(v5817.Match.AreaId) then
			return false
		end

		if v5817.Match.Rarity == nil or tostring(p506) == tostring(v5817.Match.Rarity) then
			return true
		end

		return false
	end
end

spilled.t12.wispRF = function(p507, p508)
	local Packages = spilled.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
	local Networking = Packages and Packages:FindFirstChild("Networking")
	local RFWispCompanionRequest = Networking and Networking:FindFirstChild("RF/WispCompanion/Request")

	if not RFWispCompanionRequest then
		return nil, "sem remote"
	end

	local u5821 = false
	local u5822 = false
	local u5823
	local u5824

	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, result, result2 = pcall(function()
			return RFWispCompanionRequest:InvokeServer(p507, p508)
		end)

		u5822 = ok
		u5823 = result
		u5824 = result2
		u5821 = true
	end)

	local v5828 = os.clock() + 8

	while not u5821 and os.clock() < v5828 do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end

	if not u5821 then
		return nil, "sem resposta"
	end

	if not u5822 then
		return nil, tostring(u5823)
	end

	return u5823, u5824
end
spilled.t12.wispOutroTemCorpo = function()
	return spilled.t12.rouboPausadoPeloMech == true or spilled.t12.rouboPausadoPeloCapture == true or spilled.t12.surtoComOCorpo == true or spilled.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InScrambleArena") == true or spilled.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InBossArena") == true
end
spilled.t12.wispTomarCorpo = function()
	if spilled.t12.wispOutroTemCorpo() then
		return false
	end

	if spilled.t12.rouboPausadoPeloWisp then
		return not _G.__TSUO_ROUBANDO()
	end

	if _G.__TSUO_ModoRoubo == "TWEEN" or _G.__TSUO_ModoRoubo == "TP" then
		if (_G.__TSUO_EGG_CARREGANDO or {}).ativo == true or _G.__TSUO_LINEDROP_OCUPADO == true then
			return false
		end

		spilled.t12.rouboPausadoPeloWisp = true
		pcall(_G.__TSUO_TrocarModoRoubo, "NENHUM", true)
		task.wait(0.3)
	end

	return not _G.__TSUO_ROUBANDO()
end

do
	spilled.t12.wispSoltarCorpo = function()
		if spilled.t12.rouboPausadoPeloWisp then
			spilled.t12.rouboPausadoPeloWisp = nil

			if spilled.t12.wispOutroTemCorpo() then
				return
			end

			local ultimoModoRoubo = spilled.t12.ultimoModoRoubo

			if ultimoModoRoubo == "TWEEN" or ultimoModoRoubo == "TP" then
				pcall(_G.__TSUO_TrocarModoRoubo, ultimoModoRoubo, true)
			end
		end
	end
end

		end

		spilled.v2718(p509, math.max(2, p510 - 3))

		local v5832 = spilled.v399()

		if v5832 and (p509 - v5832.Position).Magnitude <= p510 then
			return true
		end

		task.wait(0.3)
	end

	return false
end

		end

spilled.t12.fundirUmaVez = function(p552, p553)
	local ok, result = pcall(require, spilled.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Save)
	local ok2, result2 = pcall(require, spilled.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)

	if not ok or not ok2 or not result2.Fusery then
		return false, "this server has no fuse machine"
	end

	local v6140 = spilled.v1777(result)

	if not v6140 or type(v6140.Inventory) ~= "table" then
		return false, "your save has not loaded yet"
	end

	if v6140.FusionLocked == true or v6140.FusionEggReward == true then
		return false, "the machine is busy with your last fuse"
	end

	local t193 = {}
	local v6142, v6143, v6144 = pairs(v6140.EquippedAssets or {})

	for _, v in v6142, v6143, v6144 do
		t193[v] = true
	end

	local t194 = {}
	local v6148, v6149, v6150 = pairs(v6140.Inventory)

	for k, v in v6148, v6149, v6150 do
		local __TSUO_CatalogoDaCategoria = _G.__TSUO_CatalogoDaCategoria and _G.__TSUO_CatalogoDaCategoria(v.Category) or nil

		if v.InFuse ~= true and v.IsFavorite ~= true and __TSUO_CatalogoDaCategoria ~= nil and __TSUO_CatalogoDaCategoria.CannotFuse ~= true and (p553 == nil or p553[tostring(v.Category)] == true) then
			t194[v.Category] = t194[v.Category] or {}
			table.insert(t194[v.Category], {
				uid = k,
				escala = tonumber(v.Scale) or 0,
				equipado = t193[k] == true
			})
		end
	end

	local t195
	local v6155
	local v6156, v6157, v6158 = pairs(t194)
	local v6159 = geniter(v6156, v6157, v6158)
	local v6160

	while true do
		local v6161 = table.pack(v6159())

		if v6161[1] then
			v6160 = v6161[3]

			if #v6160 >= 3 then
				break
			end
		else
			return false, "you need three spare pets of the same kind"
		end
	end

	local exitTo

	repeat
		table.sort(v6160, function(p554, p555)
			if p554.equipado == p555.equipado then
				return p554.escala < p555.escala
			end

			return p555.equipado
		end)

		local v6163 = v6160[1].escala + v6160[2].escala + v6160[3].escala

		if not v6155 or v6155 < v6163 then
			v6155 = v6163
			t195 = {
				v6160[1].uid,
				v6160[2].uid,
				v6160[3].uid
			}
		end

		exitTo = nil

		while true do
			local v6164 = table.pack(v6159())

			if v6164[1] then
				v6160 = v6164[3]

				if #v6160 >= 3 then
					exitTo = 1

					break
				end
			else
				break
			end
		end
	until exitTo ~= 1

	if not t195 then
		return false, "you need three spare pets of the same kind"
	end

	local v6165, v6166, v6167 = ipairs(t195)

	for _, v in v6165, v6166, v6167 do
		if v6140.Inventory[v] and t193[v] then
			spilled.v1779(spilled.t51.PetDoff, v)
			task.wait(0.2)
		end
	end

	if v6140.FusionInfoAcknowledged ~= true then
		pcall(function()
			result2.Fusery.ConfirmBriefing:InvokeServer()
		end)
	end

	local v6170, v6171, v6172 = pairs(v6140.FusionSlots or {})

	for _, v in v6170, v6171, v6172 do
		pcall(function()
			result2.Fusery.EjectPet:InvokeServer(v)
		end)
	end

	local n186 = 0
	local v6176
	local v6177, v6178, v6179 = ipairs(t195)

	for _, v in v6177, v6178, v6179 do
		local ok3, result3, result4 = pcall(function()
			return result2.Fusery.LoadPet:InvokeServer(v)
		end)

		if ok3 and result3 then
			n186 += 1
		else
			v6176 = result4
		end

		task.wait(0.15)
	end

	if n186 < 3 then
		local v6185, v6186, v6187 = ipairs(t195)

		for _, v in v6185, v6186, v6187 do
			pcall(function()
				result2.Fusery.EjectPet:InvokeServer(v)
			end)
		end

		local v6190 = false
		local tostring_ = tostring
		local v6192 = v6176 or "the machine refused the pets"

		return v6190, tostring_(v6192)
	end

	local ok3, result3, result4 = pcall(function()
		return result2.Fusery.BeginFuse:InvokeServer()
	end)

	_G.__TSUO_FUSAO = {
		em = os.date("%H:%M:%S"),
		trio = t195,
		comecou = ok3 and result3 or false,
		motivo = tostring(result4 or "")
	}

	if ok3 and result3 then
		if p552 then
			spilled.v375("Fuse", "Merging three spare pets into a stronger one.", 5)
		end

		return true
	end

	local v6196 = false
	local v6197 = result4 or "the machine refused to start"

	return v6196, tostring(v6197)
end

					t199[k] = v
				end
			end

			v3805:SetConfig(t199, false)

			return true
		end)

		task.wait(1)

		local n193 = 0

		pcall(function()
			if type(_G.__TSUO_EGG_PERFIL_FOTO) ~= "table" then
				return
			end

			local t200 = {}

			local function v6367(p572, p573)
				if not togglesQueAgem[p572] then
					return true
				end

				if p572 == "oneclick" or p572 == "OneClick" or p572 == "oneclickbypass" or p572 == "roubarumso" then
					return false
				end

				if spilled.t12.eraReload or spilled.t11.AutoStart == true then
					return true
				end

				if p573 == true then
					t200[#t200 + 1] = tostring(p572)
				end

				return false
			end

			local t201 = {
				AutoPlant = "AutoPlant",
				AutoHatchSteal = "AutoHatch",
				AutoEquipBestSteal = "AutoEquipBest",
				AntiTrap = "AntiTrap",
				autorift = "AutoRift",
				coletarevento = "ColetarEvento",
				captureovo = "CaptureOvo",
				autorlgl = "AutoRLGL",
				autotrexrun = "AutoTrexRun",
				autoshootingstar = "AutoShootingStar",
				autoislandwars = "AutoIslandWars",
				passarelaadmin = "PassarelaAdmin",
				roubarindice = "RoubarIndice",
				somutados = "SoMutados",
				EggESP = "EggESP",
				autotrail = "AutoTrail",
				bypassdropado = "BypassDropado",
				desempatetamanho = "DesempateTamanho"
			}

			for k, v in pairs(t201) do
				local v6371 = _G.__TSUO_EGG_PERFIL_FOTO[k]

				if type(v6371) == "boolean" and spilled.t11[v] ~= v6371 and v6367(k, v6371) then
					spilled.t11[v] = v6371
					n193 += 1
					pcall(spilled.v1874, k, v6371)
				end
			end

			local t202 = {
				autotreadmill = true,
				AutoTreadmill = true,
				oneclick = true,
				OneClick = true,
				AutoSteal = true,
				autosteal = true,
				StealAir = true,
				stealair = true
			}
			local txt = type(isfile) == "function" and isfile("tsuo_saegg_esteira_migrada.txt") or false

			for k, v in pairs(_G.__TSUO_EGG_PERFIL_FOTO) do
				if type(v) == "boolean" and not t202[k] and not t201[k] and (k ~= "usaresteira" or txt) and v6367(k, v) and spilled.v1869(k) then
					n193 += 1
					pcall(spilled.v1874, k, v)
				end
			end

			local v6376 = type(_G.__TSUO_EGG_DiscoDesligado) == "function" and _G.__TSUO_EGG_DiscoDesligado()

			if v6376 then
				_G.__TSUO_EGG_DECISAO = string.format("%s disco=NENHUM (desligado pelo dedo) -> fica desligado, modo era %s", os.date("%H:%M:%S"), tostring(_G.__TSUO_ModoRoubo))
				spilled.t12.dedoDesligouRoubo = true
				task.delay(0.6, function()
					spilled.t12.usuarioLigouRoubo = false
					pcall(_G.__TSUO_TrocarModoRoubo, "NENHUM")
				end)
			elseif (spilled.t12.eraReload or spilled.t11.AutoStart == true) and _G.__TSUO_ModoRoubo == "NENHUM" then
				local v6377 = type(_G.__TSUO_EGG_ModoEmDisco) == "function" and _G.__TSUO_EGG_ModoEmDisco() or nil
				local v6378 = v6377 or _G.__TSUO_EGG_PERFIL_FOTO.StealAir == true and "TP" or _G.__TSUO_EGG_PERFIL_FOTO.AutoSteal == true and "TWEEN" or spilled.t12.ultimoModoRoubo == "TP" and "TP" or spilled.t12.ultimoModoRoubo == "TWEEN" and "TWEEN" or nil

				_G.__TSUO_EGG_DECISAO = string.format("%s disco=%s foto.Air=%s foto.Fly=%s ultimo=%s -> %s", os.date("%H:%M:%S"), tostring(v6377), tostring(_G.__TSUO_EGG_PERFIL_FOTO.StealAir), tostring(_G.__TSUO_EGG_PERFIL_FOTO.AutoSteal), tostring(spilled.t12.ultimoModoRoubo), tostring(v6378))

				if v6378 then
					task.delay(0.6, function()
						if _G.__TSUO_ModoRoubo == "NENHUM" and type(_G.__TSUO_EGG_RELIGAR) == "function" then
							pcall(_G.__TSUO_EGG_RELIGAR, v6378, spilled.t12.eraReload and "reload" or "Auto Start")
						end
					end)
				else
					task.delay(0.6, function()
						if _G.__TSUO_ModoRoubo == "NENHUM" then
							pcall(_G.__TSUO_TrocarModoRoubo, "NENHUM")
						end
					end)
				end
			else
				_G.__TSUO_EGG_DECISAO = string.format("%s pulei: reload=%s autostart=%s modo=%s", os.date("%H:%M:%S"), tostring(spilled.t12.eraReload), tostring(spilled.t11.AutoStart), tostring(_G.__TSUO_ModoRoubo))

				if _G.__TSUO_ModoRoubo == "NENHUM" then
					task.delay(0.6, function()
						pcall(_G.__TSUO_TrocarModoRoubo, "NENHUM")
					end)
				end
			end

			if not spilled.t12.eraReload and spilled.t11.AutoStart ~= true then
				pcall(spilled.v1874, "usaresteira", false)
				pcall(function()
					if _G.__TSUO_MR then
						_G.__TSUO_MR.usarEsteira = false
					end
				end)
				task.delay(7, function()
					if _G.__TSUO_MR and _G.__TSUO_MR.esteiraDesejada ~= true then
						pcall(spilled.v1874, "usaresteira", false)
					end
				end)

				if not txt then
					_G.__TSUO_EGG_ESTEIRA_MIGRADA = os.date("%H:%M:%S")

					if type(writefile) == "function" then
						pcall(writefile, "tsuo_saegg_esteira_migrada.txt", os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
					end
				end
			end

			pcall(function()
				if type(_G.__TSUO_TrocarModoRoubo) == "function" and tostring(_G.__TSUO_ModoRoubo) ~= "NENHUM" then
					_G.__TSUO_TrocarModoRoubo("NENHUM", true)
				end
			end)

			if #t200 > 0 then
				table.sort(t200)
				_G.__TSUO_EGG_SEGURADOS = string.format("%s segurei %d opcao(oes) que agem sozinhas: %s", os.date("%H:%M:%S"), #t200, table.concat(t200, ", "))
				pcall(function()
					game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
						Title = "Tsuo Hub",
						Text = string.format("%d opcao(oes) que voce deixou ligadas nao subiram sozinhas -- ligue no menu quando quiser. Nada que mexe no personagem sobe sem clique.", #t200),
						Duration = 9
					})
				end)
			end

			local function v6379(p574)
				local v6380 = _G.__TSUO_EGG_PERFIL_FOTO[p574]

				if type(v6380) ~= "table" then
					return nil
				end

				local t203 = {}

				for k, v in pairs(v6380) do
					if type(k) == "number" then
						if type(v) == "string" then
							t203[#t203 + 1] = v
						end
					elseif v then
						t203[#t203 + 1] = tostring(k)
					end
				end

				return t203
			end

			local v6384 = v6379("areafocus")

			if v6384 then
				spilled.t11.AreaFocus = v6384

				if _G.__TSUO_MR then
					local zonasEscolhidas = {}

					for _, v in ipairs(v6384) do
						zonasEscolhidas[tostring(v)] = true
					end

					_G.__TSUO_MR.zonasEscolhidas = zonasEscolhidas
				end

				pcall(spilled.v1862)
				n193 += 1
			end

			local v6388 = v6379("rarityfilter")

			if v6388 then
				spilled.t11.RarityFilter = v6388
				spilled.t11.RaridadesFoco = v6388

				if _G.__TSUO_MR then
					_G.__TSUO_MR.raridadesEscolhidas = v6388
				end

				pcall(spilled.v1866)
				n193 += 1
			end

			for _, v in ipairs({
				"scrambleprio",
				"scrambleloja",
				"oneclickpecas",
				"escolhaovo",
				"espraridades",
				"autosellraridades",
				"autosellraridadessteal"
			}) do
				local v6391 = _G.__TSUO_EGG_PERFIL_FOTO[v]

				if v6391 ~= nil and type(v6391) ~= "boolean" and spilled.v1869(v) then
					n193 += 1
					pcall(spilled.v1874, v, v6391)
				end
			end
		end)
		_G.__TSUO_EGG_CONFIG = string.format("%s config: LoadProfile %s, %d bandeira(s) na mao", os.date("%H:%M:%S"), ok and "ok" or "falhou", n193)
		spilled.t12.perfilRestaurado = true
		pcall(function()
			if _G.__TSUO_EGG_LIBERAR_PERFIL then
				_G.__TSUO_EGG_LIBERAR_PERFIL()
			end
		end)
		pcall(function()
			local activeProfile = v3805:GetActiveProfile()

			if type(v3805.SaveProfile) == "function" then
				v3805:SaveProfile(activeProfile)
			end
		end)
		pcall(function()
		end)
	end)
end

_G.__TSUO_MARCO("4 carga terminou inteira")

do
	local u6393 = false

	pcall(function()
		u6393 = _G.__TSUO_SEM_MOTOR ~= true and type(_G.__TSUO_MR) == "table" and type(_G.__TSUO_MR.dice) == "table" and type(_G.__TSUO_MR.dice.trocar) == "function"
	end)
	_G.__TSUO_BUILD = u6393 and "motor: source" or "motor: ESQUELETO (build de teste)"
end

spilled.v375("Tsuo Hub", "Loaded. " .. #spilled.t13.areaOrder .. " areas, " .. #spilled.v1787() .. " endpoints. " .. _G.__TSUO_BUILD, 6)
